task1.prompt: The pie chart below shows how an average household in one country divided its annual spending among seven categories in 2022. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sample:
The pie chart shows how a typical household in one country allocated its yearly budget across seven categories in 2022.

Overall, housing was by far the largest item of expenditure, while healthcare and education together made up a relatively small part of the total. Basic needs such as accommodation, food and transport accounted for well over half of all spending.

Housing took the biggest share, at 32%, which is almost a third of the household budget. Food came second with 18%, and transport followed at 14%. Together, these three categories represented 64% of annual spending, nearly two thirds of the total.

The remaining categories were considerably smaller. Households devoted 11% of their income to leisure, which was slightly more than the 10% spent on other items. Healthcare accounted for 8%, and education was the smallest category at just 7%. Notably, leisure spending was only three percentage points lower than the share allocated to transport, and it exceeded the figure for healthcare. In other words, families in this country spent almost as much on enjoyment as on getting around.
task1.notes_vi: Biểu đồ tròn chỉ có MỘT mốc thời gian nên không có xu hướng — hãy so sánh tỷ lệ. Dàn ý: Mở bài paraphrase; Overview (mục lớn nhất, mục nhỏ nhất, nhóm nhu cầu thiết yếu chiếm hơn một nửa); Thân bài 1: ba mục lớn nhất (housing, food, transport) + tổng cộng; Thân bài 2: các mục còn lại, so sánh leisure với transport/healthcare. Từ vựng: account for, make up, take up, the largest share, nearly a third, slightly more than, just over. Lỗi hay gặp: dùng 'increase/decrease' cho biểu đồ chỉ có một năm; không cộng các nhóm để rút ra nhận xét; ghi sai tỷ lệ (nhớ tổng = 100%); lặp 'account for' mọi câu; thiếu Overview.

task2.prompt: Levels of obesity among children are rising in many countries around the world. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?
task2.sample:
Childhood obesity has become one of the most pressing public health concerns of recent decades, with rates climbing in both wealthy and developing nations. This essay will examine the main causes of the problem and propose several practical measures to reverse the trend.

Two factors are chiefly responsible for the increase. The first is a change in diet. Cheap, heavily processed foods that are high in sugar and fat are now available everywhere and are marketed aggressively to children through television and social media. Parents who work long hours often rely on takeaway meals or ready-made snacks because they have little time to cook. The second cause is a decline in physical activity. Many children spend their free time playing video games or watching videos rather than playing outside, and in crowded cities there may be few safe places to run or cycle. School timetables, which are increasingly focused on exam results, have also reduced the time available for sport.

Fortunately, there are several ways to tackle these causes. Governments could introduce stricter rules on the advertising of unhealthy food to young people and impose a tax on sugary drinks, using the revenue to subsidise fresh fruit and vegetables in school canteens. Schools, for their part, should guarantee a minimum amount of daily exercise and teach children basic nutrition and cooking skills, so that they can make informed choices. Finally, parents can play a crucial role by setting limits on screen time and eating together as a family, which encourages healthier habits that last into adulthood.

In conclusion, rising childhood obesity results mainly from poor diets and sedentary lifestyles. By combining government regulation, better education and active parental involvement, societies can help the next generation grow up healthier.
task2.notes_vi: Dạng Problem–Solution (ở đây là causes + solutions): trả lời ĐỦ cả hai câu hỏi, mỗi câu một đoạn thân bài. Dàn ý: Mở bài (paraphrase + nêu sẽ bàn nguyên nhân và giải pháp) — Thân bài 1: 2 nguyên nhân (chế độ ăn, thiếu vận động) mỗi cái có giải thích/ví dụ — Thân bài 2: 2–3 giải pháp tương ứng với từng nguyên nhân (chính phủ, nhà trường, phụ huynh) — Kết bài tóm tắt. Lỗi hay gặp: chỉ nêu nguyên nhân mà quên giải pháp; giải pháp không khớp nguyên nhân; ý quá chung chung như 'the government should do something'; dùng 'solve' mà không nói rõ cách; dùng danh từ 'obese' thay vì 'obesity' hoặc 'obese children'.
